```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
from typing import Optional, Tuple


class ReplayCategory(Enum):
    """Per-work-item replay outcome category. Satisfies AC-16."""
    REPLAYED_OK = "replayed_ok"
    REPLAYED_DRIFT = "replayed_drift"
    HALTED = "halted"


class HaltReason(Enum):
    """Reason a work-item's replay could not complete. Satisfies AC-16."""
    REVOKED_KEY = "revoked_key"
    MISSING_WORKFLOW_VERSION = "missing_workflow_version"
    UNRECOGNIZED_TRANSITION = "unrecognized_transition"
    SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED = "signature_verification_failed"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReplayReportRow:
    """One row of replay_report_<ts>, one per work-item processed. Satisfies AC-16."""
    work_item_id: str
    category: ReplayCategory
    halt_reason: Optional[HaltReason]
    warnings: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DriftReport:
    """Aggregate replay_report_<ts> contents. Satisfies AC-16."""
    timestamp: str
    rows: Tuple[ReplayReportRow, ...]


def categorize_replay_row(
    work_item_id: str,
    replayed_final_state: Optional[object],
    live_final_state: Optional[object],
    halt_reason: Optional[HaltReason],
    warnings: int,
) -> ReplayReportRow:
    """Satisfies AC-16."""
    ...


def build_drift_report(
    timestamp: str,
    rows: Tuple[ReplayReportRow, ...],
) -> DriftReport:
    """Satisfies AC-16."""
    ...
```
